run_count_docs: run count_docs.py on a text file to count documents, average lines, and average tokens per document
run_count_docs_gzip: run count_docs.py with the --gzip flag on a gzipped text file to count documents and tokens
review_main: review the main function that parses args, opens files, and counts documents separated by empty lines
summarize_count_docs: summarize the count_docs.py script that counts documents and computes average lines and tokens per document
refactor_gopen: refactor the gopen helper function to support additional compression formats beyond gzip
